```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("mole crabs fixed swash and temp.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(

    # ===========================
    # STANDARDIZE LOCATION
    # ===========================
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WAVES
    # ===========================
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ZONE
    # ===========================
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash|surf") ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ENVIRONMENTAL NUMERIC VARIABLES
    # ===========================
    salinity = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+")),

    # ===========================
    # FIX DO
    # ===========================
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN MOON PHASE
    # ===========================
    moon_phase_clean = tolower(moon_phase),
    moon_phase_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "full") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "first|waxing") ~ "Waxing",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "last|waning") ~ "Waning",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "quarter|quater") ~ "Quarter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN TIDE STAGE
    # ===========================
    tide_clean = tolower(tide_stage),
    tide_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tide_clean, "high") ~ "High",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "low|\\bl\\b") ~ "Low",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "rising|flood|incoming") ~ "Rising",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "falling|ebb") ~ "Falling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN SKY
    # ===========================
    sky_clean = tolower(sky),
    sky_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(sky_clean, "clear|sun") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "part") ~ "Partly Cloudy",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "cloud") ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN FOAM
    # ===========================
    foam_clean = tolower(foam_floatables_y_n),
    foam_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(foam_clean, "y|foam") ~ "Foam",
      str_detect(foam_clean, "n|none|little") ~ "No Foam",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WATER CLARITY
    # ===========================
    water_clean = tolower(water_color_transparency),
    water_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(water_clean, "clear|transparent|high transparency") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(water_clean, "murky|low transparency|dark|brown|grey|cloudy") ~ "Murky",
      str_detect(water_clean, "green|olive|yellow|blue") ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove helper column
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw) %>%

  # Keep valid locations only
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%

  mutate(
    location = factor(location),
    year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
    waves_clean = factor(waves_clean, levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    moon_phase_clean = factor(moon_phase_clean,
                              levels = c("Waxing","Full","Waning","Quarter")),
    tide_clean = factor(tide_clean,
                        levels = c("Low","Rising","High","Falling")),
    sky_clean = factor(sky_clean,
                       levels = c("Clear","Partly Cloudy","Cloudy")),
    foam_clean = factor(foam_clean,
                        levels = c("No Foam","Foam")),
    water_clean = factor(water_clean,
                         levels = c("Clear","Moderate","Murky"))
  ) %>%

  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# MORE DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
# ==========================================

size_data <- size_data %>%
  mutate(
    disturbance_phase = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year == "2023" ~ "Transitional",
      year == "2024" ~ "Collapse",
      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    disturbance_phase = factor(
      disturbance_phase,
      levels = c("Baseline","Transitional","Collapse","Recovery")
    )
  )
# ----------------------------------
# Zero Proportion by Year
# ----------------------------------

zero_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(zero_year)

# ----------------------------------
# Before vs After Summary
# ----------------------------------

before_after <- size_data %>%
  group_by(disturbance_phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_count = median(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_count = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(before_after)

# ----------------------------------
# Coefficient of Variation by Size Class
# ----------------------------------

cv_table <- size_data %>%
  group_by(size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    CV = sd / mean
  )

print(cv_table)

# ----------------------------------
# Quartiles by Year
# ----------------------------------

quartiles_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    q25 = quantile(count, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(count, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(quartiles_year)

# ----------------------------------
# Observed 2024 Decline
# ----------------------------------

decline_table <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(total = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm) %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2024")) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_total = mean(total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_total)

baseline_mean <- mean(c(decline_table$`2021`,
                        decline_table$`2022`))

decline <- 1 - (decline_table$`2024` / baseline_mean)

cat("Observed 2024 decline:",
    round(decline * 100, 1), "%\n")
# ----------------------------------
# Spatial Heterogeneity
# ----------------------------------

spatial_summary <- size_data %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(spatial_summary)

# ----------------------------------
# Dispersion Metrics (NB Justification)
# ----------------------------------

mean_count <- mean(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
var_count  <- var(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Overall mean:", mean_count, "\n")
cat("Overall variance:", var_count, "\n")
cat("Variance-to-Mean ratio:",
    var_count / mean_count, "\n")
```

```{r}
  location = c("sandy_hook","bluffs","south_bath","deal","ocean_grove"),

)

site_summary <- left_join(site_summary, site_coords, by = "location")

# Clean labels
site_summary$location_clean <- dplyr::recode(site_summary$location,
  sandy_hook  = "Sandy Hook",
  bluffs      = "Bluffs",
  south_bath  = "South Bath",
  deal        = "Deal",
  ocean_grove = "Ocean Grove"
)

# ----------------------------------
# Label positioning (original spacing)
# ----------------------------------

site_summary <- site_summary %>%
  mutate(
    label_lon = lon - 0.025,
    label_lat = case_when(
      location == "sandy_hook" ~ lat + 0.01,
      location == "bluffs" ~ lat + 0.010,
      location == "south_bath" ~ lat - 0.010,
      location == "deal" ~ lat - 0.005,
      location == "ocean_grove" ~ lat - 0.008,
      TRUE ~ lat
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ==========================================

observed_size <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_per_scoop = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_per_scoop - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_per_scoop + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

ggplot(observed_size,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_per_scoop,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(observed_size$year_num))
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Abundance (Crabs per Scoop)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temporal Abundance by Size Class"
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPERATURE RELATIONSHIP
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ----------------------------------

# ---- Add per-scoop standardization ----
size_data_temp <- size_data %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    cps = count / scoops   # crabs per scoop
  )

# ---- Binned summary ----
obs_temp <- size_data_temp %>%
  mutate(temp_bin = round(water_temp * 2) / 2) %>%   # 0.5°C bins
  group_by(size_class, temp_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cps = mean(cps, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(cps, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data_temp,
    aes(x = water_temp,
        y = pmax(cps, 0.01),
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        ymin = pmax(mean_cps - se, 0.01),
        ymax = mean_cps + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(0.05, 150),
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100)
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Water Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Mean Abundance (log scale crabs per scoop)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temperature and Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# BIOMASS DECLINE
# ==========================================

# ---- Compute biomass ----
biomass_zone <- size_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024","2025"),
         zone %in% c("bore","swash")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_biomass - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_biomass + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year)))

# ---- Calculate recovery metrics ----
metrics <- biomass_zone %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2024","2025")) %>%
  dplyr::select(zone, year, mean_biomass) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_biomass)

# Collapse (should be nearly identical across zones)
collapse_pct <- round(
  mean((1 - metrics$`2024` / metrics$`2021`) * 100),
  0
)

# Zone-specific net recovery
metrics <- metrics %>%
  mutate(
    Net_Recovery = round((`2025` / `2021`) * 100, 0)
  )

swash_recovery <- metrics$Net_Recovery[metrics$zone == "swash"]
bore_recovery  <- metrics$Net_Recovery[metrics$zone == "bore"]

# ---- Disturbance Band ----
disturbance <- data.frame(
  xmin = 2023,
  xmax = 2024,
  ymin = min(biomass_zone$lower),
  ymax = max(biomass_zone$upper)
)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(biomass_zone,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_biomass,
           color = zone,
           fill = zone,
           group = zone)) +

  geom_rect(data = disturbance,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = xmin,
                xmax = xmax,
                ymin = ymin,
                ymax = ymax),
            fill = "red",
            alpha = 0.07) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.18,
              color = NA) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +

  # ---- Dynamic Annotations ----
  annotate("text",
           x = 2023.5,
           y = max(biomass_zone$upper) * 0.5,
           label = paste0("Disturbance\n~",
                          collapse_pct, "% Collapse from baseline"),
           color = "red",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 5,
           hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("bore" = "darkgreen",
                                "swash" = "limegreen")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("bore" = "darkgreen",
                               "swash" = "limegreen")) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2021,2022,2023,2024,2025)) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Biomass (mm × count)",
    color = "Zone",
    fill = "Zone",
    title = "Zone-Specific Biomass Collapse and Divergent Recovery",
    subtitle = "Baseline biomass estimated at 2021-2022"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# SAMPLE-LEVEL DEMOGRAPHIC TESTS (FIXED)
# ==========================================

# ------------------------------------------
# 1. Build Independent Sample Dataset
# ------------------------------------------

sample_struct <- size_data %>%
  group_by(date, location, zone, year) %>%
  summarise(
    small  = sum(count[size_class == "Small (2mm)"]),
    medium = sum(count[size_class == "Medium (6mm)"]),
    large  = sum(count[size_class == "Large (12mm+)"]),
    total  = small + medium + large,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total > 0) %>%
  drop_na(year, zone)   # FORCE same rows for all models

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. GLOBAL DEMOGRAPHIC SHIFT
# ------------------------------------------

global_data <- sample_struct   # lock dataset

global_model <- glm(
  cbind(small, total - small) ~ year + zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = global_data
)

global_null <- glm(
  cbind(small, total - small) ~ zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = global_data
)

cat("\n===== GLOBAL DEMOGRAPHIC SHIFT =====\n")
print(summary(global_model))

cat("\n===== LRT: YEAR EFFECT =====\n")
print(anova(global_null, global_model, test = "F"))

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. BASELINE HABITAT PARTITIONING
# ------------------------------------------

baseline_data <- sample_struct %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022"))

baseline_model <- glm(
  cbind(large, total - large) ~ zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = baseline_data
)
deviance(baseline_model) / df.residual(baseline_model)
cat("\n===== BASELINE ADULT PARTITION =====\n")
print(summary(baseline_model))

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. PHASE EFFECT ON ADULT STRUCTURE
# ------------------------------------------

phase_data <- sample_struct %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year %in% c("2023","2024") ~ "Disturbance",
      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase))   # ensure same rows for both models

adult_model <- glm(
  cbind(large, total - large) ~ phase + zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = phase_data
)

adult_null <- glm(
  cbind(large, total - large) ~ zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = phase_data
)

cat("\n===== ADULT STRUCTURE ~ PHASE =====\n")
print(summary(adult_model))

cat("\n===== LRT: PHASE EFFECT ON ADULT STRUCTURE =====\n")
print(anova(adult_null, adult_model, test = "F"))

# ------------------------------------------
# 5. PHASE EFFECT ON JUVENILE STRUCTURE
# ------------------------------------------

juvenile_model <- glm(
  cbind(small, total - small) ~ phase + zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = phase_data
)

juvenile_null <- glm(
  cbind(small, total - small) ~ zone,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = phase_data
)

cat("\n===== JUVENILE STRUCTURE ~ PHASE =====\n")
print(summary(juvenile_model))

cat("\n===== LRT: PHASE EFFECT ON JUVENILE STRUCTURE =====\n")
print(anova(juvenile_null, juvenile_model, test = "F"))
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# STRUCTURAL BREAK – BASELINE vs DISTURBANCE
# ==========================================

# ---- 1. Create dominant size class per sample ----
sample_demo <- sample_struct %>%
  mutate(
    dominant_class = case_when(
  small == medium & medium == large ~ NA_character_,
  small  >= medium & small  >= large ~ "Small",
  medium >= small  & medium >= large ~ "Medium",
  large  >= small  & large  >= medium ~ "Large",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
  )

# ---- 2. Collapse to 2 phases (Baseline vs Disturbance) ----
sample_break <- sample_demo %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024")) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = ifelse(
      year %in% c("2021","2022"),
      "Baseline",
      "Disturbance"
    ),
    phase = factor(phase,
                   levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance"))
  )

# ---- 3. Build contingency table ----
demo_table <- table(sample_break$phase,
                    sample_break$dominant_class)

print(demo_table)

# ---- 4. Check expected counts ----
chi_test <- chisq.test(demo_table)

print(chi_test)
print(chi_test$expected)

# ---- 5. If expected counts < 5, use simulated p-value ----
if(any(chi_test$expected < 5)) {
  chi_test <- chisq.test(demo_table,
                         simulate.p.value = TRUE,
                         B = 10000)
  cat("\nUsing simulated p-value (small sample correction)\n")
  print(chi_test)
}

# ---- 6. Compute Cramér’s V ----
n_total <- sum(demo_table)

min_dim <- min(nrow(demo_table) - 1,
               ncol(demo_table) - 1)

cramers_v <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_test$statistic) /
  (n_total * min_dim)
)

cat("\nCramer's V (Baseline vs Disturbance):",
    round(cramers_v, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# Baseline Ontogenetic Partitioning
# (Contingency-table version for effect size)
# ------------------------------------------

baseline_struct <- sample_struct %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022"))

# Adult dominant vs zone
baseline_struct <- baseline_struct %>%
  mutate(adult_dominant = large > medium & large > small)

partition_table <- table(
  baseline_struct$zone,
  baseline_struct$adult_dominant
)

chi_part <- chisq.test(partition_table)

print(chi_part)

n_part <- sum(partition_table)

cramers_v_part <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_part$statistic) /
    (n_part * (min(dim(partition_table)) - 1))
)

cramers_v_part <- round(cramers_v_part, 2)

cat("\nCramer's V =", cramers_v_part, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE MODELING DATASET
# (Baseline collapsed 2021–2022)
# ----------------------------------

analysis_data <- size_data %>%
  
  # Exclude control/outside site
  filter(location != "sandy_hook") %>%
  
  # Remove zero effort
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # Log sampling effort
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    
    # Center date
    date_numeric = as.numeric(date),
    date_c = date_numeric - mean(date_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    #Water temp
    water_temp_c = water_temp - mean(water_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Center environmental predictors
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # ---- Collapse 2021–2022 to Baseline ----
    year = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      TRUE ~ as.character(year)
    ),
    
    year = factor(year,
                  levels = c("Baseline",
                             "2023",
                             "2024",
                             "2025")),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  drop_na(count, scoops, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

# Set reference levels
analysis_data$location <- relevel(analysis_data$location,
                                  ref = "south_bath")

analysis_data$year <- relevel(analysis_data$year,
                              ref = "Baseline")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# FORMAL TEST: ZONE × YEAR INTERACTION
# Likelihood Ratio Test (LRT)
# ==========================================

# ----------------------------------
# Fit Model WITHOUT interaction
# (Assumes same temporal trend in both zones)
# ----------------------------------

nb_no_interaction <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location +
          zone +
          year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

# ----------------------------------
# Fit Model WITH interaction
# (Allows temporal trends to differ by zone)
# ----------------------------------

nb_with_interaction <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location +
          zone * year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

# ----------------------------------
# Likelihood Ratio Test
# ----------------------------------

lrt_result <- anova(nb_no_interaction,
                    nb_with_interaction,
                    test = "LRT")

print(lrt_result)

# ----------------------------------
# Zone × Year IRRs From Interaction Model
# ----------------------------------

coefs <- coef(nb_with_interaction)
vc    <- vcov(nb_with_interaction)

years_to_extract <- c("2023","2024","2025")

zone_year_irr <- lapply(years_to_extract, function(yr) {
  
  year_term  <- paste0("year", yr)
  inter_term <- paste0("zoneswash:year", yr)
  
  # -------------------------
  # Bore (reference zone)
  # -------------------------
  
  beta_bore <- coefs[year_term]
  var_bore  <- vc[year_term, year_term]
  se_bore   <- sqrt(var_bore)
  
  irr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore)
  lwr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore - 1.96 * se_bore)
  upr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore + 1.96 * se_bore)
  
  # -------------------------
  # Swash
  # -------------------------
  
  beta_swash <- coefs[year_term] + coefs[inter_term]
  
  var_swash <- vc[year_term, year_term] +
               vc[inter_term, inter_term] +
               2 * vc[year_term, inter_term]
  
  se_swash <- sqrt(var_swash)
  
  irr_swash <- exp(beta_swash)
  lwr_swash <- exp(beta_swash - 1.96 * se_swash)
  upr_swash <- exp(beta_swash + 1.96 * se_swash)
  
  rbind(
    data.frame(
      Zone = "Bore",
      Year = yr,
      IRR = irr_bore,
      Lower_95CI = lwr_bore,
      Upper_95CI = upr_bore,
      Percent_Change = (1 - irr_bore) * 100
    ),
    data.frame(
      Zone = "Swash",
      Year = yr,
      IRR = irr_swash,
      Lower_95CI = lwr_swash,
      Upper_95CI = upr_swash,
      Percent_Change = (1 - irr_swash) * 100
    )
  )
})

zone_year_irr <- do.call(rbind, zone_year_irr)
rownames(zone_year_irr) <- NULL
print(zone_year_irr)
summary(nb_with_interaction)$coefficients[
  grep("zoneswash:year2025",
       rownames(summary(nb_with_interaction)$coefficients)), ]
```

```{r}
coefs <- coef(nb_full_interaction)
vc    <- vcov(nb_full_interaction)

# -----------------------------
# BORE (reference zone)
# -----------------------------

beta_bore <- coefs["year2024"]
var_bore  <- vc["year2024","year2024"]
se_bore   <- sqrt(var_bore)

irr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore)
lwr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore - 1.96 * se_bore)
upr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore + 1.96 * se_bore)

collapse_bore <- round((1 - irr_bore) * 100, 1)

# -----------------------------
# SWASH
# -----------------------------

beta_swash <- coefs["year2024"] +
              coefs["zoneswash:year2024"]

var_swash <- vc["year2024","year2024"] +
             vc["zoneswash:year2024","zoneswash:year2024"] +
             2 * vc["year2024","zoneswash:year2024"]

se_swash <- sqrt(var_swash)

irr_swash <- exp(beta_swash)
lwr_swash <- exp(beta_swash - 1.96 * se_swash)
upr_swash <- exp(beta_swash + 1.96 * se_swash)

collapse_swash <- round((1 - irr_swash) * 100, 1)

# -----------------------------
# Print Results
# -----------------------------

collapse_results <- data.frame(
  Zone = c("Bore","Swash"),
  IRR_2024 = c(round(irr_bore,3),
               round(irr_swash,3)),
  Lower_95CI = c(round(lwr_bore,3),
                 round(lwr_swash,3)),
  Upper_95CI = c(round(upr_bore,3),
                 round(upr_swash,3)),
  Percent_Decline = c(collapse_bore,
                      collapse_swash)
)

print(collapse_results)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# MODEL-BASED TEMPORAL TREND

analysis_data$fitted <- fitted(nb_full_interaction)

model_year <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fit = mean(fitted),
    se = sd(fitted) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_fit + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_fit = pmax(mean_fit, 1e-6),
    lower = pmax(lower, 1e-6),
    upper = pmax(upper, 1e-6),
    year_num = case_when(
      year == "Baseline" ~ 2021.5,
      year == "2023" ~ 2023,
      year == "2024" ~ 2024,
      year == "2025" ~ 2025
    )
  )

# ----------------------------------
# Calculate % decline Baseline → 2024
# ----------------------------------

baseline_vals <- model_year %>%
  filter(year == "Baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(size_class, mean_fit)

yr2024_vals <- model_year %>%
  filter(year == "2024") %>%
  dplyr::select(size_class, mean_fit)

decline_df <- left_join(baseline_vals,
                        yr2024_vals,
                        by = "size_class",
                        suffix = c("_base", "_2024")) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_decline = round(
      100 * (1 - mean_fit_2024 / mean_fit_base), 1
    )
  )

# ----------------------------------
# Build annotation text (OUTSIDE ggplot)
# ----------------------------------

decline_text <- decline_df %>%
  arrange(size_class) %>%
  mutate(line = paste0(size_class, ": -", pct_decline, "%")) %>%
  summarise(label = paste0(
    "Disturbance\n",
    paste(line, collapse = "\n")
  ))

annotation_df <- data.frame(
  x = 2023.5,
  y = max(model_year$upper) * 0.9,
  label = decline_text$label
)

# ----------------------------------
# Disturbance ribbon
# ----------------------------------

disturbance_band <- data.frame(
  xmin = 2023,
  xmax = 2024,
  ymin = 0,
  ymax = max(model_year$upper)
)

# ----------------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------------

ggplot(model_year,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_fit,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_rect(data = disturbance_band,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,

                ymin = ymin,

  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +

  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# ZONE- AND SIZE-SPECIFIC TEMPERATURE EFFECTS
# (From Final 3-Way Interaction Model)
# ==========================================

coefs <- coef(nb_full_interaction)
vc    <- vcov(nb_full_interaction)

sizes <- levels(analysis_data$size_class)
zones <- levels(analysis_data$zone)

temp_effects <- list()
counter <- 1

for (z in zones) {
  for (s in sizes) {
    
    beta <- coefs["water_temp_c"]
    var  <- vc["water_temp_c","water_temp_c"]
    
    size_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s)
    if(size_term %in% names(coefs)){
      beta <- beta + coefs[size_term]
      var  <- var +
        vc[size_term,size_term] +
        2*vc["water_temp_c",size_term]
    }
    
    zone_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:zone", z)
    if(zone_term %in% names(coefs)){
      beta <- beta + coefs[zone_term]
      var  <- var +
        vc[zone_term,zone_term] +
        2*vc["water_temp_c",zone_term]
    }
    
    sz_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s, ":zone", z)
    if(sz_term %in% names(coefs)){
      beta <- beta + coefs[sz_term]
      var  <- var +
        vc[sz_term,sz_term] +
        2*vc["water_temp_c",sz_term]
    }
    
    se <- sqrt(var)
    
    temp_effects[[counter]] <- data.frame(
      Zone = z,
      Size_Class = s,
      IRR_per_1C = round(exp(beta),3),
      Lower_95CI = round(exp(beta - 1.96*se),3),
      Upper_95CI = round(exp(beta + 1.96*se),3),
      Percent_Change = round((1-exp(beta))*100,1)
    )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

temp_effects <- bind_rows(temp_effects)
print(temp_effects)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# FORMAL TEST: Zero Inflation (Sample-Level)
# ==========================================

sample_level <- clean_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook") %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    total_count = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm,
    phase = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year %in% c("2023","2024") ~ "Disturbance",
      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    phase = factor(phase,
                   levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance","Recovery")),
    zero_flag = ifelse(total_count == 0, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase))

logit_zero_sample <- glm(
  zero_flag ~ phase + log(scoops),
  family = binomial,
  data = sample_level
)

summary(logit_zero_sample)

cat("\nOdds ratios for zero probability (sample-level):\n")
print(exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(logit_zero_sample),
  confint.default(logit_zero_sample)
)))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FINAL MODEL DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
# (Run after all models are fit)
# ============================================================

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("MODEL DIAGNOSTIC CHECKS\n")
cat("=============================\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BINOMIAL OVERDISPERSION CHECK
# ------------------------------------------------------------
check_overdisp <- function(model, name){
  ratio <- deviance(model) / df.residual(model)
  cat("\n---", name, "---\n")
  cat("Dispersion ratio:", round(ratio, 3), "\n")
  if(ratio > 1.5){
    cat("⚠ Potential overdispersion detected.\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ No serious overdispersion.\n")
  }
}

if(exists("global_model")) check_overdisp(global_model, "Global Demographic Model")
if(exists("adult_model")) check_overdisp(adult_model, "Adult Structure Model")
if(exists("juvenile_model")) check_overdisp(juvenile_model, "Juvenile Structure Model")
if(exists("logit_zero_sample")) check_overdisp(logit_zero_sample, "Zero Inflation Model")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. NEGATIVE BINOMIAL DISPERSION ADEQUACY
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("nb_full_interaction")){
  cat("\n--- Negative Binomial Dispersion ---\n")
  cat("Theta:", round(nb_full_interaction$theta, 4), "\n")
  if(nb_full_interaction$theta < 0.2){
    cat("⚠ Very strong overdispersion (small theta).\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ Dispersion parameter reasonable.\n")
  }
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SINGULARITY CHECK
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("nb_full_interaction")){
  cat("\n--- Rank Deficiency Check ---\n")
  mm <- model.matrix(nb_full_interaction)
  qr_rank <- qr(mm)$rank
  full_rank <- ncol(mm)
  cat("Model rank:", qr_rank, "of", full_rank, "\n")
  if(qr_rank < full_rank){
    cat("⚠ Model matrix is rank deficient (missing combinations).\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ No rank deficiency detected.\n")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DATE CLUSTERING TEST (Need Random Effects?)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("analysis_data")){
  
  # Fit model with date as fixed effect proxy
  nb_date_fixed <- glm.nb(
    count ~ log_scoops +
      water_temp_c * size_class +
      location + year * zone +
      factor(date),
    data = analysis_data
  )
  
  cat("\n--- Date Clustering Test ---\n")
  print(anova(nb_full_interaction, nb_date_fixed, test="LRT"))
  
  p_date <- anova(nb_full_interaction, nb_date_fixed, test="LRT")$`Pr(Chi)`[2]
  
  if(!is.na(p_date) && p_date < 0.05){
    cat("⚠ Significant date clustering detected.\n")
    cat("→ Consider glmmTMB with random intercept for date.\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ No strong evidence for date-level clustering.\n")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("nb_full_interaction")){
  
  cat("\n--- Residual Diagnostics ---\n")
  
  pearson_resid <- residuals(nb_full_interaction, type="pearson")
  fitted_vals <- fitted(nb_full_interaction)
  
  cat("Residual mean:", round(mean(pearson_resid),3), "\n")
  cat("Residual SD:", round(sd(pearson_resid),3), "\n")
  
  if(abs(mean(pearson_resid)) < 0.1){
    cat("✓ Residuals centered appropriately.\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠ Residuals not centered at zero.\n")
  }
  
  cor_rf <- cor(pearson_resid, fitted_vals)
  cat("Residual vs fitted correlation:", round(cor_rf,3), "\n")
  
  if(abs(cor_rf) < 0.2){
    cat("✓ No major pattern in residuals.\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠ Possible model misspecification.\n")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. MULTICOLLINEARITY (VIF)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nb_additive <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location +
          zone +
          year,
  data = analysis_data
)
if(exists("nb_additive")){
  cat("\n--- Variance Inflation Factors ---\n")
  vif_vals <- try(car::vif(nb_additive), silent=TRUE)
  if(!inherits(vif_vals, "try-error")){
    print(vif_vals)}}

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("END DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("=============================\n")
```
